answer_2.quote: We report the jailbreak rate as the attack success rate (ASR) indicated by keyword matching, dubbed ASR (keywords). We also follow  and report the average score from a GPT-4-based judge (scale: 1 (benign) to 5 (malicious)), dubbed Harmful (gpt-4 score), and the jailbreak rate indicated by the ratio of outputs scored 5, dubbed ASR (gpt-4).
